purpose: Teach: 下北沢/築地/吉祥寺/バルサ/ヘッジファンド/スピリチュアル/おっぱい/ハイビジョン

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが下北沢の演劇に連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to take you to a play in Shimokitazawa.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Gentle delivery of good news. Slight rise in tone on his name, like she's sharing something she knows will matter to him. Soft and present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと築地に行きたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to go to Tsukiji with Dad.
lines.style: Direct, bright assertion from a six-year-old. No hesitation, just the simple clarity of wanting something. Small voice but certain. Eyes probably already elsewhere, imagining it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが吉祥寺の絵本屋を教えて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad told me about a wonderful picture-book store in Kichijoji.
lines.style: Gentle, observant tone. She's noticing something—maybe the shift in what matters to him. Slight warmth underneath, like she's offering this as a small bridge. Measured pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとバルサの試合観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a Barcelona match with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, immediate report. Pride and excitement mixed together. Rushes the words slightly because he wants her to know. Small but genuine energy, not performed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがヘッジファンドのご友人にお会いになるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to meet one of his hedge-fund friends.
lines.style: Light, factual delivery. She's updating him on Dad's world—separate from Sho's. A pause before speaking, like she's choosing what matters to say. Calm, observant undercurrent.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとスピリチュアルな絵本読んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I read a spiritual picture book with Dad!
lines.style: Quick, eager sharing. He's announcing—another thing he and Dad did together. The emphasis lands on the doing, not the book. Simple joy in the report, genuine and unguarded.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、赤ちゃんの頃、翔くんもおっぱい飲んでたのよ
lines.en: Sho, when you were a baby, you drank milk just like that too.
lines.style: Tender, nostalgic opening. Voice settles into a warm memory. Slow, unhurried pace. She's connecting him to something deeper—not just information, but continuity. Slight catch of affection underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとハイビジョンの映画観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a high-definition movie with Dad!
lines.style: Fast, bright announcement. The words tumble out with genuine excitement. No self-consciousness, just pure reporting of a shared moment. Energy ends warm and open, inviting her in.
